description: Transactiedata parkeren Arnhem is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Gemeente Arnhem. De open parkeerdata van de gemeente Arnhem bevat transactiedata per maand vanaf 1 januari 2014. Aan het begin van iedere kalendermaand wordt de data van de maand daarvoor aangeboden. U vindt hier de transacties vanuit het straat parkeren (meer dan 100 parkeerautomaten en 13 mobiele zones) en vanuit de gemeentelijke parkeergarages Musis, Rozet en Centraal. Coverage: Gemeente Arnhem. The portal files it under the publisher Gemeente Arnhem. Its tags are Belprovider, CSV, Centraal, Musis, Parkeergarage. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
